description: The file defines data classes and a parser object for processing 'talk directive' JSON input in a voice-related Android application. It includes functions for parsing JSON and extracting specific configuration options for voice synthesis.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various configurable parameters for a talk directive, such as voice, speed, style, and language.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Contains the result of parsing a directive, including the parsed directive, the remaining text, and any unknown keys identified.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse input text, extract JSON directive, and identify unknown keys.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Parses a line of text as a JSON object.
